test_personachat_default_teacher: run pytest to test the default personachat teacher using AutoTeacherTest regression checks
test_personachat_none_teacher: run pytest to test the personachat:none teacher variant with AutoTeacherTest regression checks
test_personachat_self_variants: run pytest to test personachat self, self_original, and self_revised teacher variants
test_personachat_other_variants: run pytest to test personachat other, other_original, and other_revised teacher variants
test_personachat_both_variants: run pytest to test personachat both, both_original, and both_revised teacher variants
